summary: Frontend-only polish iteration verified end-to-end on preview URL (1920x1200). All 5 polish items PASS: (1) Old tagline 'sender deg tilbake til deg selv' fully removed from Landing. (2) New prominent Bragarmål quote 'er norrønt og står for skaldens språk — den fremste diktekunst' rendered with visible red left border (3px solid rgb(200,67,44), paddingLeft 20px). (3) All 4 favicon assets return HTTP 200 (favicon.ico 575B, favicon-16.png 546B, favicon-32.png 1.4KB, apple-touch-icon.png 12.6KB); browser tab title contains 'Bragarmål'. (4) og-image.png is the new 1200x630 6-box grid preview with BRAGARMĀL wordmark + tagline (72,351 bytes, >50KB threshold; visually confirmed grid layout not centered logo). (5) Boot loader #bragr-boot present at initial DOM load with pulsing logo image, receives 'hide' class after React mount, and is removed from DOM within ~1.2s (opacity fade observed at 0.086 mid-transition). Boot background pure white (#ffffff) as required — no color flash. Performance: first-contentful-paint = 288ms (<< 1500ms target). No console errors on Landing page. Regression: all 6 hero boxes navigate correctly (manifest→/manifest, examples→/eksempler, image→/etikk, tools→/dashboard [redirects to / for unauth as expected], register→/logg-inn, pricing→/priser).
critical_code_review_comments: Boot loader remove()+setTimeout in App.js useEffect is clean and correct; no leak risk since #bragr-boot is only queried once.

og:image meta uses absolute IDN URL 'https://bragarmål.no/og-image.png' — verified with SEO tools that Facebook/Twitter unescaped Unicode host may need punycode (xn--bragarml-l8a.no) for maximum crawler compatibility. Current preview loads the file correctly via relative path though. Non-blocking.

Quote block uses var(--moss) but computed color is rust red (200,67,44). Variable naming is misleading (--moss usually implies green) but the visual result matches the review requirement. Consider renaming for readability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_7 covered polish-only frontend verification. Landing quote block, favicons, og-image (new grid), boot loader, and 6-box nav all verified. FCP 288ms. No console errors. Auth-gated boxes correctly bounce unauth users. Previous iteration_6 covered 14-day trial, box order, sparringspartner move (still intact per this run).
